title: OrbitUtils
description:
Orbit is a all-in-one Paper 1.21 server utility plugin featuring homes, warps, TPA, kits, mail, nicknames, vanish,
  fly, god mode, and more
body:
Running a Minecraft server shouldn't mean managing a dozen plugins just to cover the basics. Orbit is a single,
  lightweight Paper 1.21 utility plugin that replaces the whole stack — built from the ground up to be clean, fast, and
  actually fun to manage.

  Teleportation & Navigation
  Set multiple homes, create server warps, send TPA requests, and jump back to your last location instantly. Players can
   toggle TPA requests on or off, and admins can set a custom spawn point per world. Everything just works, no config
  headaches.

  Player Tools
  Fly, god mode, heal, feed, speed, vanish, AFK — all the essentials are here. Staff can apply them to other players
  too. Nicknames support full MiniMessage color formatting for staff, so your server can look as polished as you want.

  Inventory & Items
  Open your ender chest or a crafting table anywhere, anytime. Repair your gear on the spot, throw on a hat, toss
  unwanted items in the trash, or clear your inventory in one command. Admins can spawn any item directly with /item.

  Kits
  Create kits straight from your inventory — no YAML editing, no item lists to type out by hand. Set cooldowns per kit,
  and players can browse what's available with a single command. Simple for players, powerful for admins.

  Offline Mail
  Players can send messages to anyone, even if they're offline. Mail sits in the inbox until the player logs in, then
  they get a notification and can read it with /mail read. Great for keeping a community connected.

  Built-in Permission System
  No LuckPerms? No problem. Orbit ships with its own full group system — create groups, set prefixes and suffixes,
  define permissions, set inheritance chains, all in-game with /group and /perm. Got LuckPerms installed? Orbit detects
  it automatically and hands permission control straight over without skipping a beat. Either way, chat formatting with
  colored prefixes and suffixes works out of the box.

  Social Spy & Private Messaging
  Staff can silently monitor private messages in real time with /socialspy. Reply tracking works with vanilla /msg too,
  so players don't need to learn new commands — /r just works.

  Server Info & Playtime
  Check live TPS, memory usage, and player counts with /sinfo. Track how long anyone has played with /playtime —
  sessions are accurate and persist across restarts.

  Rules
  Set and update your server rules in-game with /rules set. Players can read them anytime. No files to edit, no restarts
   required.

  The /orbit Menu
  Every single feature is laid out in a clean, 54-slot inventory GUI. New players can browse everything the server
  offers, click a button, and get going — no command memorization required. Staff features are documented right there in
   the tooltips.

  PlaceholderAPI & TAB Support
  Orbit registers placeholders for nickname, AFK status, vanish, god mode, fly, and ping — ready to use in TAB,
  scoreboards, holograms, or any other placeholder-aware plugin the moment you install it.
